embeds.title: 2 providers on DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 are saving OpenRouter users $446.5K a year over CrofAI

provider        in/cached/out  paid/yr  saved/yr
------------------------------------------------
Relace    0.04  /0.008 /0.08    615.7K    437.4K

footer.text: Prices per 1M tokens. Traffic from OpenRouter, week ending 2026-08-23. Annualised from one week. CrofAI costed optimistically, at its reported 83% cache hits or better.
